title: Dedup built into the judge (node-level) + KB consolidated; recall-loose/agent-precise confirmed
summary: The judge now adjudicates NODES (duplicate notes), not just edges, on the same RAG-recall→agent-adjudicate→reversible-apply pattern. Substrate: lib/judge.js dupClusters (cosine union-find) + clusterSignature/clusterPending/stampCluster; /judge/next serves a third 'dup-cluster' item kind (epoch+signature watermarked); /judge/verdict consolidate{keep,supersede[],why} (supersedeNote → re-point context edges onto keeper → drop self-loops → stamp judged) and surfaceCluster{keys,why} (cluster-level guidance). Pairwise surfaceSupersede RETIRED. THRESHOLD FINDING: no single cosine reproduces the duplicate clusters (true-dup intra-cosine spans 0.555–0.871); 0.70 over-merges (precision 0.07), 0.84 under-recalls (0.30). Chose 0.80 as the RECALL bar (precision 0.50/recall 0.55, cap=8) and let the AGENT supply precision — exactly the recall→adjudicate split. Dogfood result: 113 pairwise supersede guidance items CLEARED; 8 clusters auto-consolidated, 10 notes superseded (current notes 152→142), 11 context edges re-pointed onto keepers, 0 dangling edges; 4 ambiguous clusters SURFACED not merged (benchmark v2/v3/v4/v5 series kept distinct; ON-vs-OFF scenarios kept distinct) — honest false-positive avoidance. Reversibility proven: superseded notes carry validTo + supersededBy chain, recoverable via /search?asOf. 29 test suites green. The judge loop now keeps EDGES honest (reasoned, acyclic) and NODES honest (deduplicated), continuously, budgeted+parallel on the heartbeat.
